title: FAQ: prices, timelines, warranty — CAS Development, Kyiv
description: Answers to common questions: design and renovation prices, stages, 12-month warranty, ±5% estimate when CAS renovates, furniture from China and Ozdoba.
h1: Frequently asked questions about design, renovation and furnishing
lead: The questions clients ask most often — about prices, stages, warranty, the design project and furniture from China. Didn’t find yours? Leave a request at the bottom of the page and we will answer personally.

faq: How much does an apartment design project cost?
From $30 per m², with a minimum project budget of $2 500.
How much does turnkey renovation cost?
From $550 per m² for apartments and houses, from $350 per m² for offices. The exact amount is fixed in the estimate before the start.
What is included in the price from $550/m²?
Works and rough materials. Finishing materials, furniture and appliances are priced separately in the estimate, depending on the items chosen.
How much does a site measurement cost?
Measurement and inspection of the property are arranged individually, and the cost is calculated case by case.
And construction or furnishing?
Construction from $600 per m², a turnkey house with finishing from $1 100 per m², turnkey furnishing from $250 per m².
Can you invoice a company?
Yes, we invoice companies registered in Ukraine and provide closing documents. Invoicing for EU companies — being set up.
What is the warranty on works?
12 months.
Can the renovation cost grow during the process?
If CAS Development carries out the renovation to our project, the total does not deviate from the approved estimate by more than ±5%.
How many projects have you completed?
150+ projects since 2016.
Can you work with me if I am not in Ukraine?
Yes. The brief, presentations and approvals run online, and the drawings are ready for a local contractor.
What is the easiest way to contact you?
WhatsApp, Telegram or Viber at +380 97 866 77 55, or the form at the bottom of the page.
How does ordering furniture from China work?
We agree samples, colours and price with delivery; the factory produces, we check quality and arrange delivery. Delivery takes 30–60 days.
Can I buy a single item from Ozdoba?
We do not sell single pieces. The minimum order is $500, and different items can be combined in it.
